notes: Almost every name gives the condition and the expected result, and the body checks it byte for byte (e.g. test_get_refuses_a_mapping_or_list_with_the_show_hint, test_removing_the_source_comments_gives_the_unlabelled_output). One name says more than its body checks: test_sources_without_path_labels_the_whole_configuration asserts only one labelled line plus that stripping labels gives the plain output. One pair is too vague to tell apart: test_empty_collections_are_printed_as_braces_and_brackets vs test_printed_empty_collections_are_braces_and_brackets.
